description: The image shows a wide, multi-lane roadway with no visible continuous sidewalk; instead, there is a narrow dirt shoulder on the right that is uneven and cluttered with construction debris, with no clear curb or curb cuts for accessibility. Traffic appears separated only by the road edge (no pedestrian barriers), and vehicles are traveling on the open roadway with no pedestrian crossing or lighting visible. There is little to no greenery or shade, and the right-side verge has loose soil and scattered objects that would be difficult and unsafe for walking.
